answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 147712 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to give money for conducting programs like bayans of Rabi Awwal? Question: When people come to me for contributions for conducting programs like bayans of Rabi Awwal, is it permissible to give them money? Answer ID: 147712 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 446/494=5/1438) It is not proved from the Salaf to organize programs or celebrate julus etc on 12 day of Rabi Awwal. Thus if people approach you on this occasion for donation, you should avoid it as it is very much possible that your money is spent in unwanted things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
